name: wake-on-lan
title: Wake-on-LAN
description: Wakes a computer of your network with a magic packet, from a card on the home screen of your dashboard and a page at /v1/wake_on_lan/. The module lets any signed-in account wake a saved device and only the administrator change the list; on a ReCasaOS box the gateway gives other accounts no write access, so in practice the administrator does both.
